newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end weaker across the board.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end weaker across the board.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended weaker across the board on Tuesday, as selling accelerated in the afternoon session after the market failed to post a significant technical rebound, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.4 yen to 2.0 yen per kg lower. Benchmark February was 2.0 yen weaker at 137.9 yen.

The market started the day on a firmer tone due to some technical buying. But amid lingering concerns over rising domestic stocks, selling gradually overwhelmed buying, sending prices into negative territory by the close, they said.
